patch.answer: The petrol Nexon has a published boot capacity of 382 litres, measured to ISO V215.
Tata advertises a basic warranty of three years and one lakh kilometres. The supplied brochure doesn't explain which limit applies first or the exclusions, so please confirm the full warranty terms.
Yes. The documented Fearless + PS petrol and diesel versions include ventilated driver and co-driver seats, along with rear AC vents.
In the documented petrol and diesel range, Pure + and higher have a 26.03 cm HARMAN touchscreen. Fearless + PS also has a 26.03 cm digital driver display.
